description: Create a new order for the company. Use Type "Inbound" to restock items from a supplier (the default) or "Outbound" to ship items out. Supply a name and the line items to order (each line is an inventory item plus a count). Identify each line's item by inventoryItemId (from get_inventory) or by itemName. Items not listed are still added to the order with a count of zero, just like creating an order in the app. Setting a count increases the item's on-order amount (Inbound) or outbound amount (Outbound); finishing the delivery is done separately when the order is completed.
name: create_order
